name: Secure the Mountain

angles.text: As a dwarf, reclaiming the Grizzled Den helps protect mountaineers and travelers from wendigos encroaching on Dun Morogh's paths.
As an Alliance member, you help get Whitebeard the intelligence he needs to maintain border security against threats in the mountains.

faq.answer: Cornelius is a scout whose partner waits outside the Grizzled Den. He charged into the wendigo-filled cavern to secure Whitebeard's report, and his partner needs help finding him.
The Grizzled Den is a cavern north of the mountaineers' post. Wendigos that usually keep to deep mountain hollows have overrun it in large numbers.
Wendigos have begun multiplying and spreading rapidly across the snowy mountain crags. Their numbers add to the danger scouts already face from local Frostmane trolls.
Whitebeard awaits an essential report on mountain conditions. Cornelius went into the Grizzled Den to secure it.
faq.q: Who is Whitebeard and what is his report?

faq.answer: You enter the Grizzled Den to find Cornelius and thin out the wendigos overrunning the cave.
faq.q: What is the goal of Secure the Mountain?

faq.answer: Frostmane trolls already threaten scouts in the peaks. The sudden surge in wendigos adds another danger for patrols on the mountain passes.
faq.q: How do the trolls factor into the mountain's troubles?

sections.body: Wendigos are multiplying across the cold mountain slopes and crowding into the Grizzled Den to the north. Dwarven scouts already contend with Frostmane trolls. Now savage beasts make the crags perilous for patrols and couriers.
sections.title: A Den Overrun

sections.body: Cornelius charged into the Grizzled Den to secure Whitebeard's vital report. His partner waits outside, seeking help to find the scout and thin the ferocious wendigos in the cave.
sections.title: Reckless Valor

summary: You face a growing danger in Dun Morogh: wendigos have overrun the Grizzled Den, and Whitebeard's report is missing. Cornelius entered the cavern while his partner waited outside.
